aboutUs.heading: The Keepers
aboutUs.subheading: The collectors, designers, and technologists behind Perfumer's Hollow.

content.subheading: Two collectors chasing the scent of something rare
content.one: Late at night, long after the city quiets down, you’ll usually find us surrounded by perfume bottles, scattered notes, and conversations about fragrances we still can’t stop thinking about.
content.two: We’re Brian and Amanda — the husband-and-wife team behind Perfumer’s Hollow.
content.three: What began as a personal way to track our growing collection slowly became something larger. One bottle led to another, notes turned into records, and over time those records became the foundation for the Archive you see today.
content.four: Perfumer’s Hollow was built from a shared belief that fragrance is more than luxury. Every scent carries atmosphere, memory, emotion, and story — and the people who collect perfume understand that better than anyone.
content.five: The platform continues to grow one fragrance, one house, and one collector at a time. Every review adds perspective. Every wishlist sparks discovery. Every exchange helps keep perfume culture alive and moving forward.
content.six: We created this space for the curious — the collectors, romantics, archivists, and late-night explorers who know that sometimes a single note can stay with you for years.
content.seven: And if something is missing from the Archive, let us know. We’re always searching for the next great discovery.
content.eight: So step in from the rain, stay awhile, and explore the Hollow with us.

meta.title: The Collector’s Guide - perfumer's hollow
meta.description: Learn how perfumer's hollow works.

howItWorks.heading: The Game of Bottles and Trust
howItWorks.subheading: Your guide to the Archive and Exchange.

section1.title: Step One: Light Your Match — Create an Account
section1.content: Creating an account opens the door to Perfumer’s Hollow — a hidden network where collectors, archivists, and fragrance enthusiasts gather to explore, review, exchange, and document the scents worth remembering.
section1.content2: Visitors may still wander the Archive freely, but participation belongs to those who choose to step deeper into the Hollow.
section1.content3: The first 100 memberships are complimentary — a quiet acknowledgment of the early collectors who discovered the Hollow before the lights came on.
section1.content4: And your information remains yours. Never sold. Never traded. Never shared beyond the Hollow.

section2.title: Step Two: List Your Decants — Share the Scent
section2.content: Some fragrances are too good to remain undiscovered.
section2.content2: Listing your decants allows other collectors to experience the bottles that shaped your journey — from rare finds and discontinued favorites to everyday signatures worth revisiting.
section2.content3: Describe the fragrance, document its character, and share what made it memorable to you. Every listing adds something new to the Archive and helps fellow collectors uncover scents they may never have encountered otherwise.
section2.content4: Perfumer’s Hollow provides the space for these exchanges to happen openly and transparently. While we do not handle exchanges or payments directly, we help collectors connect through a trusted and community-driven platform.

section3.title: Step Three: Build Your Wishlist — Chase the One That Got Away
section3.content: Every collector remembers certain fragrances — the discontinued favorite, the impossible-to-find bottle, the scent that never fully left memory.
section3.content2: Your wishlist keeps those discoveries close.
section3.content3: Save the fragrances you’ve been searching for and receive notifications when they appear within the Hollow. Over time, your wishlist becomes more than a collection of bottles — it becomes a record of personal taste, memories, and the scents still waiting to be rediscovered.

section4.title: Step Four: Make the Exchange — The Quiet Exchange
section4.content2: When collectors connect through the Hollow, they arrange exchanges directly — discussing details, making offers, and building trust through a shared appreciation for fragrance.
section4.content3: Perfumer’s Hollow does not process transactions or handle payments. We simply provide the platform where collectors can connect, communicate, and arrange exchanges transparently.
section4.content4: What happens next belongs entirely to the collectors involved.

section5.title: The Sillage We Leave Behind
section5.content: Perfumer’s Hollow exists for collectors who understand that fragrance is never just fragrance.
section5.content2: It is memory. Atmosphere. Discovery. A fleeting moment that somehow stays with you long after it disappears.
section5.content3: Every review, exchange, and saved bottle adds another layer to the growing Archive and the community shaping it.
section5.content4: We value curiosity over trends, privacy over noise, and genuine passion over performance.
section5.content5: In the end, the fragrance fades. What remains is the connection it created.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.question1: How do I add a missing perfume or perfume house?
faq.answer1: If you notice a perfume or perfume house missing from our database, you can submit it using the buttons below. Your submission will be reviewed by an admin before being added to the database. We're always looking to expand our collection and appreciate your help in making perfumer's hollow more complete.
faq.question2: How does the trading system work?
faq.answer2: perfumer's hollow provides a platform for collectors to connect and exchange. We don't handle transactions or payments directly — those are arranged between you and your trading partner. We simply provide the space and tools to make those connections happen safely and transparently.
faq.answer3: Absolutely. We take privacy seriously. We don't sell, exchange, or share your personal information. Your data stays yours, and what happens in the shadows stays there.
faq.question4: How do I create an account?
faq.answer4: Creating an account is free and easy. Simply click the 'Sign In' button in the navigation, then choose 'Sign Up' to create your account. Accounts are free for the first 100 members, and we keep it that way to honor our early supporters.
faq.question5: Can I review perfumes without an account?
faq.answer5: You can browse and search the site without an account, but to rate, review, list decants, or build your wishlist, you'll need to create an account. It's free and gives you access to the full perfumer's hollow experience.
faq.question6: What if I find an error in the database?
faq.answer6: We appreciate your attention to detail! If you spot an error — whether it's a misspelling, incorrect information, or a duplicate entry — please let us know via email. We'll review it and make corrections as needed.

meta.description: Shipping expectations, dispute process, and community rules for traders.

communityPolicy.heading: Collector Standards
communityPolicy.subheading: Shared expectations for Echanges, reviews, and community participation.

intro.heading: A Thoughtful Community
intro.subheading: Perfumer’s Hollow exists to support collectors, discovery, and respectful Exchanges. These standards help keep the Hollow fair, trustworthy, and welcoming for everyone.

shipping.heading: Shipping & Packaging
shipping.contentOne: All payments and shipping arrangements are handled directly between collectors. Confirm carriers, packaging expectations, and shipping timelines before sending a fragrance.
shipping.contentTwo: Ship within a reasonable timeframe after both collectors confirm the Exchange — typically within one week unless otherwise agreed. Share tracking information whenever possible.
shipping.contentThree: Package fragrances securely using proper padding and sealed decants, and disclose any known flaws or damage before shipping.

practicesContent.one: Confirm shipping timelines before sending fragrances.
practicesContent.four: Disclose flaws, leaks, or missing presentation honestly.

disputes.heading: Exchange Disputes
disputes.contentOne: If an issue arises during an Exchange, contact the other collector first and attempt to resolve it directly.
disputes.contentTwo: If the issue cannot be resolved, use Open Dispute from the active Exchange entry, or Report from a collector’s ledger for concerns unrelated to an Exchange. Include clear descriptions and supporting photos whenever possible.
disputes.contentThree: Perfumer’s Hollow reviews reported concerns and may take moderation or account action when necessary. While we do not process payments or guarantee refunds, we do enforce Collector Standards and community policies across the platform.

practicesContent.three: Include photos and supporting details when reporting issues.
practicesContent.four: Use Exchange-linked dispute tools whenever possible.

community.heading: Community Expectations
community.contentOne: Accurately represent bottle condition, remaining volume, authenticity, and presentation. Listings should include clear and current photos whenever possible.
community.contentTwo: Harassment, fraudulent activity, and repeated shipping failures are prohibited. Ongoing issues may result in moderation action, account restrictions, or suspension.
community.contentThree: Leave feedback only after a completed Exchange so collector reviews remain accurate and meaningful.

offPlatform.heading: Off-Platform Payments
offPlatform.contentOne: Perfumer’s Hollow connects collectors, but all payments and shipping arrangements are handled independently between members.
offPlatform.contentTwo: Use payment methods you trust, keep important Exchange communication within the Hollow whenever possible, and never share passwords or unrelated financial information.

practicesContent.one: Use payment methods you personally trust.
practicesContent.two: Never share passwords or verification codes.
practicesContent.three: Keep important Exchange communication within the Hollow when possible.
practicesContent.four: Be cautious with collectors requesting rushed or unusual payment arrangements.

meta.title: Terms of Use - Perfumer's Hollow
meta.description: Terms of use, trading rules, and privacy policy for perfumer's hollow.

termsAndConditions.heading: Terms of Use
termsAndConditions.subheading: Guidelines for using the Hollow, participating in Exchanges, and interacting with the collector community.

gist.heading: The Hollow at a Glance
gist.contentOne: Perfumer’s Hollow is an independent platform for fragrance collectors, reviewers, and enthusiasts — a place to discover scents, share impressions, and connect with other members of the community.
gist.contentTwo: Collectors may list fragrances, decants, and samples through the Exchange, but all arrangements are handled directly between users.
gist.contentThree: Perfumer’s Hollow does not process payments, verify authenticity, or mediate disputes. We provide the meeting place — the exchange itself belongs to the collectors involved.

tradingAndListing.heading: Exchange and Listings
tradingAndListing.contentOne: All Exchanges are conducted at the participating collectors’ own discretion and risk.
tradingAndListing.contentThree: Decants and split fragrances are permitted when accurately described and represented as authentic.
tradingAndListing.contentFour: Fraudulent activity, misrepresentation, or attempts to exchange stolen goods may result in permanent account removal and possible reporting to relevant authorities.
tradingAndListing.contentFive: Listings should accurately reflect bottle condition, fill level, vintage status, and presentation.

accountsAndConduct.heading: ACCOUNTS AND COMMUNITY CONDUCT
accountsAndConduct.contentOne: An account is required to participate in Exchanges, reviews, discussions, and collector features. Browsing the Archive and Houses remains publicly accessible.
accountsAndConduct.contentTwo: Members are expected to interact respectfully and responsibly. Harassment, spam, illegal activity, and unrelated political or religious debates are prohibited.
accountsAndConduct.contentThree: Perfumer’s Hollow exists to support fragrance discussion and collector discovery. Treat fellow collectors with the same respect you would expect in a trusted boutique or private fragrance gathering.

reviewsAndNotes.heading: REVIEWS AND NOTES
reviewsAndNotes.contentOne: Members may submit reviews, notes, and fragrance impressions to support discovery across the Hollow.
reviewsAndNotes.contentTwo: Contributions may be moderated to ensure relevance, fairness, and community quality standards. Perfumer’s Hollow reserves the right to remove content that violates these guidelines.
reviewsAndNotes.contentThree: By submitting content, you grant Perfumer’s Hollow a non-exclusive license to display your contributions within the platform and related community features. Ownership of your content remains yours.

noGuarantee.heading: NO GUARANTEES
noGuarantee.contentOne: Perfumer’s Hollow is provided “as is” without guarantees of uninterrupted availability or feature permanence.
noGuarantee.contentTwo: Features, tools, and services may change, be suspended, or be removed at any time.

liability.heading: LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
liability.contentOne: Perfumer’s Hollow and its operators are not responsible for disputes, losses, damages, or outcomes related to user Exchanges, listings, or communications.
liability.contentTwo: All Exchange arrangements are made directly between collectors.

privacy.heading: PRIVACY POLICY
privacy.contentOne: Perfumer’s Hollow respects your privacy and handles account information responsibly.

contentList.one: Information Collected: We may collect basic account information (such as username, email, and preferences) to help personalize your experience and improve the site.
contentList.two: Use of Data: Data is used internally only — for recommendations, feature improvements, and fraud prevention. It is never sold, never shared with advertisers, and never used for resale or marketing beyond this site.
contentList.three: Cookies: Like many websites, we use cookies to remember your session and keep you logged in.
contentList.four: Security: We take reasonable steps to protect your data, but no system is impenetrable. Handle your account credentials as carefully as you’d handle your favorite perfume bottle.
contentList.five: Contact: For questions, data requests, or to report suspicious activity, reach us at [INSERT CONTACT EMAIL HERE].

changes.heading: CHANGES TO THESE TERMS
changes.contentOne: These Terms and related policies may be updated periodically. Continued use of the platform after updates indicates acceptance of the revised terms.

closing.heading: CLOSING WORDS
closing.contentOne: Perfumer’s Hollow exists to celebrate the artistry, memory, and discovery behind fragrance.
closing.contentTwo: Exchange fairly, contribute thoughtfully, and trust your instincts as much as your nose.
